description: Defines a header-only template class 'HeaderOnlyArrayRef' which provides a lightweight, header-only array reference implementation with various constructors, accessors, and utility methods. It is a subset of 'ArrayRef' tailored for header-only use cases within the PyTorch codebase.

classes.name: HeaderOnlyArrayRef
classes.description: A header-only, lightweight array reference template class supporting various constructors, element access, slicing, comparison, and conversion to std::vector.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of the array.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of the array.

methods.name: cbegin
methods.description: Returns const iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: cend
methods.description: Returns const iterator to the end.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the end.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: allMatch
methods.description: Checks if all elements satisfy a predicate.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the array is empty.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the data buffer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks element-wise equality with another array.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a subarray starting at N with length M, or from N to end.

methods.name: vec
methods.description: Converts the array reference to std::vector.
